source.text_it: Se il veicolo è munito di un cronotachigrafo digitale, dalla memoria dell’apparecchio è possibile stampare gli eccessi di velocità verificatisi negli ultimi 10 anni

records.localized_text: If a vehicle has a digital tachograph, speeding events from the last 10 years can be printed from its memory.

source.text_it: Dalla memoria della carta tachigrafica del conducente è possibile risalire alla sua attività lavorativa dei 365 giorni precedenti

records.localized_text: The driver tachograph card's memory can be used to reconstruct the driver's work activity for the preceding 365 days.

source.text_it: Il pannello in figura segnala veicoli adibiti al trasporto di una specifica merce pericolosa secondo l’ADR

records.localized_text: The panel shown identifies vehicles carrying a specific dangerous good under ADR.

rows.text: The printout shows overspeed events retained under selective criteria, not a complete record of the last ten years.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, 3.12.8, requisito 117 e appendice 4, 3.6: selezione degli eventi registrati e stampati; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/annex/1 https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/annex/1/appendix/4

rows.text: The card has limited capacity: older data can be overwritten, so a 365-day activity history is not guaranteed.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, 4.5.3.1.9, requisiti 266–267 e 3.14.2, requisito 148: capacità minima di 28 giorni di attività media e sostituzione dei dati più vecchi; https://www.mcw.gov.cy/mcw/ems/ems.nsf/All/58E44816FC79CE064325797B004A77C3/%24file/Implementing%20Regulation%20EU%202016-799_EN.pdf

rows.text: The technical printout concerns tachograph identification and calibration, not engine type or fuel supply.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 4, 3.5 PRT_012: contenuto della stampa tecnica; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/annex/1/appendix/4/division/1

rows.text: The technical printout includes calibration data such as tyre size, but not the tyre brand.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 4, 3.5 e 3.21, requisito 202: stampa tecnica e misura degli pneumatici nella taratura; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/annex/1/appendix/4/division/1

rows.text: The circular symbol resembling a steering wheel identifies driving and its duration.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: volante: guida e tempo di guida. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The bed symbol identifies rest, distinct from driving and other work.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: letto: riposo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The crossed hammers indicate other work: work activities other than driving.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: martelli incrociati: altri lavori. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The square with a diagonal indicates availability, distinct from driving, work and rest.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: quadrato diagonale: disponibilità. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The two vertical bars indicate a break and the cumulative duration of driving breaks.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: due barre: pausa e tempo cumulato. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: OUT identifies an out-of-scope condition, not a driver activity.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: OUT: fuori campo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The ship pictogram indicates a ferry or train crossing condition.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: nave: traghetto/treno. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The T-shaped symbol identifies the workshop or test station, associated with inspection and calibration.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: T: officina o centro di prova. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The rectangular symbol with a projection identifies the control authority, not a driving activity.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: rettangolo con sporgenza: controllo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The rectangular symbol with a central projection at the top identifies the company and its mode.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: rettangolo con sporgenza superiore: azienda. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The circle resembling a steering wheel indicates driving; tyre size has a different pictogram.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: volante: guida; simbolo distinto per misura pneumatici. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The circle with a hand represents the clock, not recreational activities.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: orologio: tempo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The T-shaped symbol identifies the workshop; crossed hammers indicate other work.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: T: officina; martelli: altri lavori. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The rectangular symbol with a projection indicates control; rest is represented by the bed.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: controllo; letto: riposo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The symbol with a central projection at the top indicates the company; ferry or train has a different pictogram.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: azienda; simbolo distinto per traghetto/treno. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The two bars indicate a driving break; OUT indicates an out-of-scope condition.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: pausa; OUT: fuori campo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The square with a diagonal indicates availability; the company has a different symbol.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: disponibilità; simbolo distinto per azienda. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The crossed hammers indicate other work; the workshop is represented by the T-shaped symbol.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: martelli: altri lavori; T: officina. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The ship indicates a ferry or train crossing; driving is represented by the steering wheel.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: nave: traghetto/treno; volante: guida. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The two bars indicate a driving break; the control authority has a different symbol.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 2016/799, allegato I C, appendice 3, PIC_001; figura del quesito: pausa; simbolo distinto per controllo. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2016/799/pdfs/eur_20160799_2016-05-26_en.pdf

rows.text: The numbered plate identifies the hazard and substance: 33 indicates a highly flammable liquid and 1203 identifies petrol.
evidence: BAM DGG-Info, ADR UN 1203, pannello arancione: 33 liquido molto infiammabile, 1203 benzina; https://www.dgg.bam.de/dgginfo/detailinfo/adr/iccsjthezzxjv?lang=en
